title: Present Perfect with ever, never, just, already and yet

lessons.title: Present Perfect with ever, never, just, already and yet
lessons.content: We can use ever, never, just, already and yet with the present perfect to talk about life experiences, recent events, and expected actions.

details.explanation: We use 'ever' in questions with the present perfect. It means 'at any time in your life'. Ever comes just before the past participle.
details.example: Have you ever worn a suit? Has she ever appeared on TV?
details.burmese: 'ever' ကို present perfect နဲ့ questions တွေမှာ သုံးပါ။ 'ဘယ်တုန်းကများ' ဆိုတဲ့ အဓိပ္ပာယ်ပေးပါတယ်။ past participle ရဲ့ ရှေ့မှာ ထားပါ။

details.explanation: We use 'never' in negative sentences in the present perfect. It means 'at no time in your life'. Never comes before the past participle.
details.example: I have never been to London. He has never done the shopping.
details.burmese: 'never' ကို present perfect နဲ့ negative sentences တွေမှာ သုံးပါ။ 'ဘယ်တုန်းကမှ' ဆိုတဲ့ အဓိပ္ပာယ်ပေးပါတယ်။ past participle ရဲ့ ရှေ့မှာ ထားပါ။

details.explanation: We use 'just' with the present perfect to emphasize the fact that something happened very recently. Just goes before the past participle.
details.example: I have just washed my hair. Has she just taken the rubbish out?
details.burmese: 'just' ကို present perfect နဲ့ ဖြစ်ပျက်ပြီးခါစ အရာတွေကို ပြောဖို့ သုံးပါ။ past participle ရဲ့ ရှေ့မှာ ထားပါ။

details.explanation: We use 'already' to talk about something that has happened earlier than we expected. Already usually goes just before the past participle.
details.example: Don't buy any bread. I have already bought some. They have already switched off the TV.
details.burmese: 'already' ကို မျှော်လင့်ထားတာထက် စောပြီးဖြစ်ပျက်တဲ့ အရာတွေကို ပြောဖို့ သုံးပါ။ past participle ရဲ့ ရှေ့မှာ ထားပါ။

details.explanation: We use 'yet' to ask if something expected has happened or to say that it hasn't. It is used in questions or negative sentences. Yet usually goes at the end of a sentence or clause.
details.example: Have you spoken to the teacher yet? I haven't read the book yet. She hasn't arrived yet.
details.burmese: 'yet' ကို မျှော်လင့်ထားတဲ့ အရာတစ်ခု ဖြစ်ပျက်ပြီးလား မဖြစ်သေးဘူးလား မေးဖို့ သုံးပါ။ questions နဲ့ negative sentences တွေမှာ သုံးပြီး ဝါကျရဲ့ အဆုံးမှာ ထားပါ။
